pre_2018_debt_limit.description: Limit on qualifying debt taken out on or before December 15, 2017, on which home mortgage interest can be deducted, for filers other than married filing separately.

pre_2018_debt_limit_mfs.description: Limit on qualifying debt taken out on or before December 15, 2017, on which home mortgage interest can be deducted, if married filing separately.

post_2017_debt_limit.description: Limit on qualifying debt taken out after December 15, 2017, on which home mortgage interest can be deducted, for filers other than married filing separately.

post_2017_debt_limit_mfs.description: Limit on qualifying debt taken out after December 15, 2017, on which home mortgage interest can be deducted, if married filing separately.

home_acquisition_debt_limit.description: Home acquisition debt limit (other than grandfathered debt), under Home acquisition debt limit, for filers other than married filing separately.

home_acquisition_debt_limit_mfs.description: Home acquisition debt limit (other than grandfathered debt), under Home acquisition debt limit, if married filing separately.

home_acquisition_debt_limit_after_2017.description: Home acquisition debt limit for a home purchased in tax years beginning after 2017, for filers other than married filing separately.

home_acquisition_debt_limit_after_2017_m.description: Home acquisition debt limit for a home purchased in tax years beginning after 2017, if married filing separately.

salt_deduction_limit.description: Limit on the itemized deduction for state and local taxes, including real estate taxes.
